values.note: Gravel parking aprons average 15 by 61 feet; 'Interior roads are narrow in places, with trees close to the roadway.'

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/reservoir-lake-campground-and-picnic-area ('The site includes 16 designated campsites', 'Parking aprons average 15 by 61 feet and are gravel. Interior roads are narrow in places, with trees close to the roadway.'; last updated August 28, 2026), read 2026-10-22

values.note: The description lists drinking water, but the page's Current Conditions say 'Drinking water is currently unavailable at this campground.' Bear-resistant food boxes; no garbage service (pack it in, pack it out). Primitive boat ramp on the 11-acre non-motorized lake.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/reservoir-lake-campground-and-picnic-area ('Vault toilet(s)'; 'Drinking water is currently unavailable at this campground.'; 'Potable water is not available at this site.'; 'Bear-resistant food storage boxes are available, but there are no garbage services here'; 'Boat ramp is primitive'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Forest Service: 'Annually from mid-June through September, weather dependent.' Not reachable by wheeled vehicles in winter (winter parking about 5 miles from the campground).

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/reservoir-lake-campground-and-picnic-area (Reservations: 'First come-first served.'; 'Please limit your stay to 16 days.'), read 2026-10-22

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/reservoir-lake-campground-and-picnic-area ('Single Site: $15 per night', 'There is a $15.00/night fee for this campground, with an additional $5.00 fee for extra vehicles.'), read 2026-10-22

note: Beaverhead-Deerlodge NF (Dillon RD) campground on the south shore of Reservoir Lake at ~7,000 ft, ~18 mi up gravel Bloody Dick Rd (FR 181) from Highway 324, plus a day-use picnic area. Campendium flags big-rig access. --Claude
summary: Forest Service page (updated Aug 28, 2026): confirmed 16 sites, FCFS, $15/night (+$5 extra vehicle), vault toilets; added 16-day limit, mid-June to September season, apron size (15x61 ft avg). Drinking water now unavailable per Current Conditions (derived potable_water true -> false). Alerts: only food-storage and pallet orders. Note trimmed of restated values.
